meta.title: Sell YT: buy PT → merge → repay POL (one atomic transaction)

messages.label: Buy y PT for Q POL
Merge y PT + your y YT
Receive y − Q POL
messages.note: Indicative only — execution follows the pool state at fill time

cards.title: Receipt and protection
items: A sell sets a minimum-receive floor; you can also set a price-protection limit with an expiry, and falling below it rolls back the whole transaction
Quotes are indicative only; within the protection limit the fill can still be worse (MEV / market moves)
One atomic execution: either everything completes, or it rolls back unchanged

cards.title: Fees and fills
items: One underlying trade, one fee, charged on the full PT-leg size (amplified relative to the principal)
Fills depend on pool depth; no size is guaranteed to execute (clean failure)
Fee rules are exactly those of a normal PT/POL trade

cards.title: Preconditions and scope
items: Available only during the Locked phase
Receive y − Q POL; the larger Q, the less you net
